description:
FOUND (s526w1, Data-Dumper t/dumper.t row 190 "$obj->Dump in list context set $@": got `PCL: statement dropped at (eval) line 1: join " ", new Data::Dumper [[]],[] =>->Dump -- WTF? :-) Expr starts with ->/brace??`).
perl parses `new Data::Dumper [[]],[] =>->Dump` as `Data::Dumper->new([[]], [])->Dump`?? -- to verify: the fat comma before `->` ends the indirect-object argument list.  A LOUD drop (announce + die in eval), not silent.  Related: not-supported.md "Indirect object syntax with a SCALAR invocant" (MAYBE LATER, USER s425) -- this one is a CLASS invocant, which works in the plain spelling.
Rows: Data-Dumper dumper.t 190.  Layer: PExpr (indirect-object argument extent).
subject: The indirect-object call `new Data::Dumper [[]],[] =>->Dump` (a method call chained after a fat comma) is DROPPED in a string eval: "Expr starts with ->/brace??"
